answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 175 identities means 175 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the karst pair is tracked in the wharf ledger, the summit audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 52%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
